title: Geologic & conceptual models
description: 3D structural and conceptual geological models built in Leapfrog® and GemPy, integrating surface geology, well data and regional structure into a shared framework for the reservoir team.

title: Geophysics & geochemistry integration
description: Interpretation of resistivity, gravity, seismic and fluid-chemistry surveys, integrated directly into the conceptual and numerical reservoir models.

title: Well targeting
description: Candidate well locations and trajectories ranked against the geologic and numerical models, balancing resource temperature, permeability and drilling risk.

title: Well design
description: Trajectory, casing and completion design for exploration, production and injection wells, matched to the expected downhole pressure and temperature regime.

title: Reservoir simulation & modelling
description: Physics-based natural-state and production simulation with HPC-scale uncertainty quantification — our founding discipline.

title: Well testing & equipment design
description: Design and testing of downhole and surface well-test equipment for flow, injectivity and completion testing programs.

title: Well logging — PTS & ABI
description: Pressure-temperature-spinner (PTS) and acoustic borehole imaging (ABI) logging services to characterise feed zones and confirm wellbore integrity.
